sources.title: AminVilan/ppo-LunarLander-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: The Github repository contains a trained Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent for the classic control task LunarLander-v3 from Gymnasium. The model is implemented and trained using the Stable-Baselines3 library.

sources.title: suveda999/ppo-LunarLander-v3 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: PPO LunarLander-v3 This is a Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) agent trained using Stable-Baselines3 on the LunarLander environment.
